title: Harm From Hexxy
description: Have you ever wanted Hexxy to beat you to death?
body:
# Have you ever wanted Hexxy to beat you to death?

This mod makes that possible, if you commit the cardinal sin of Consideration.

More specifically, it detects when the pattern for Consideration is added to introspection/retrospection's escaped iota stack, and summons 3-8 Hexxies which are immediately aggro'd on you.

Hexxy texture by kineticcat
